notes: The window now shows everything at a real 100 % size, also when Windows' display scaling is 125 % or 150 % (change it under Settings → Size of text and buttons). The activity panel at the bottom no longer opens by itself — click the bar to see it (it still opens when the program updates itself). The status column shows the full version instead of cutting it off, and addon cards in Browse no longer show half a line of text.
